onboarding.termsSubtitle: Please read and agree to the following before creating your account.
onboarding.termsBody1: By continuing, you authorize Concordia Pharmacy to securely transfer your prescription records, medication history, refill information, and related pharmacy data into your ConcordiaCare app account. This allows your medications to appear automatically in the app whenever your pharmacist adds or updates a prescription.
onboarding.termsBody2: Your health information is protected under applicable privacy laws. Concordia Pharmacy will only share data necessary to manage your medications and provide pharmacy services. Your information will never be sold to third parties. You may request deletion of your data at any time by contacting the pharmacy.
onboarding.termsBody3: ConcordiaCare is a pharmacy management tool designed to help you track your medications, request refills, communicate with your pharmacist, and manage your health. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your doctor or pharmacist before making changes to your medications.
onboarding.termsBody4: If you designate a caregiver or family member as a proxy, you authorize them to view and manage your medication information within the app on your behalf. You can revoke proxy access at any time from your profile settings.
onboarding.termsCheckbox: I have read and agree to the above terms and authorize Concordia Pharmacy to transfer my medication records to this app.

Eating fiber-rich foods helps with medication absorption.
